title: Inspect pending and ended session presentations
description: A developer inspects the shipped SessionSecurity and Feedback components. Pending controls disclose draft/order consequences; ended feedback reveals through the shared animation and has the same result under reduced motion. The browser clock and scenario frames are explicit component fixtures, not authentication, credential revocation or multi-device service evidence.

steps.description: Freeze browser playback only. The session-ending specimen never authenticates or revokes a real account; live account recovery remains separately tested.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Inspect the disabled ending control and the complete consequences of ending sessions.
steps.acknowledgement: Both production presentations report “Keep this window open while your sessions end.” with identical text.
verifications: Both modes disclose saved identity, cancelled unacknowledged orders and cleared unsaved drafts while the ending action is disabled.
